Delete-one jackknife SE for TDNN rank-weighted estimators (internal)

Source: R/user-tdnn-core.R
dot-tdnn_jackknife_se_loo_matrix.Rd

Mirrors .dnn_jackknife_se_loo_matrix() with the DNN rank-weight spec replaced by the TDNN rank-weight spec.

Usage

.tdnn_jackknife_se_loo_matrix(
  x_mat,
  x0_mat,
  signal,
  distance,
  method,
  s1,
  s2,
  dim,
  normalize,
  ctx,
  signal_arg = "signal",
  jackknife = c("fast", "loo"),
  precomputed_ranks = NULL,
  precomputed_groups = NULL
)

Arguments

x_mat

Numeric matrix (n x p).

x0_mat

Numeric matrix (m x p) of target points.

signal

Numeric vector/matrix of per-observation signal values (n x q).

distance

Distance spec or registered name.

method

"exact" or "asymp".

s1

Integer; smaller U-statistic order.

s2

Integer; larger U-statistic order.

dim

Integer; localization dimension.

normalize

Logical; passed to the asymptotic rank-weight constructor.

ctx

Optional context.

signal_arg

Name of signal argument for error messages.

jackknife

One of "fast" (default) or "loo".

precomputed_ranks

Optional precomputed n x m integer rank matrix (only used by the fast path; if NULL ranks are computed internally).

Value

Numeric matrix (q x m) of jackknife standard errors.

Details

Fast path (jackknife = "fast"): computes full-sample ranks and the deletion weight table once, then uses the shared centered prefix/suffix engine. No distances are recomputed.

LOO fallback (jackknife = "loo"): for each i, recomputes weights from scratch on the (n-1) reduced dataset. Strictly slower; useful for validation.
